svg.text: A RasterX tile is one typed struct — shared by both tiers — carrying raster bytes (or a bytes-free reference) with grid, clip, CRS and format metadata
struct<cellid, raster, path, window, clip_polygon, clip_crs, crs, metadata>
Grid cell id — null unless tessellated
Encoded raster bytes — null when virtual
Pixel window to read / already read
same struct · bytes present vs. bytes-free reference
rst_fromcontent / GDAL reader / any rst_* output
